properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): an existing outside part (flo2's gateway, in the ikg design) tripped level_spine_disagreement and was nested INSIDE the engine to clear it, which misstates it. The honest cure already worked: contain it directly under the Project. But the 2026-09-16 fix named that cure only in orphan_level's message. The sibling rule, which the same root cause named, still says only "nothing contains it"
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-09-29, item I11 of art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29.

① OBSERVED (friction #9, 0.74.0): "cmp:flo2-edge-gateway sat at the spine root because it is outside the engine" and raised level_spine_disagreement. Workaround: "nest it under the engine's serving tier, which misstates it as part of the engine." Expected: a way to mark a component as external, or context, not part of this system's spine.

② PRECEDENT, searched verbatim:
- fact:root-cause-a-childless-root-part-has-no-legal-level-because-two-self-limiting-hierarchy-rules-were-never-checked-jointly (2026-09-16) found that BOTH hierarchy rules accept a Project parent and NEITHER message named it. It is superseded by chg:four-root-causes-from-two-field-reports-are-fixed-at-the-cause.
- That fix changed only orphan_level's wording.

③ CANDIDATES:
- (a) no honest placement for an outside part exists;
- (b) a placement exists and was not findable from the message;
- (c) the rule misfires on a correct design;
- (d) the observation is wrong.

④⑤ MEASURED in an isolated scratch graph on the installed 0.74.0:
- A Project, a `system` engine and a `component` gateway at the root: hierarchy_issues reports level_spine_disagreement on the gateway ("declares level 'component' but sits at the ROOT of the spine — nothing contains it, while 'system' exists above it").
- `add_component` drew no Project CONTAINS.
- After `contains {project_id, child_id: cmp:ext-gw}`, the finding is GONE, and the gateway is a sibling of the engine under the Project, not a part of it.
- hierarchy.rs:426-457 accepts a Project parent. Its message offers no cure. The orphan_level message beside it does.
So (a) and (c) are refuted, and (b) holds. The report's conclusion, "had to nest it inside the engine", is overturned: an honest placement existed.

⑥ CLASS: the fix was made where it was reported, and the sibling was never asked. The 09-16 root cause named two rules and the fix reached one. It recurs in the same week as the parks wording reaching orphan_node but not unsatisfied_requirement (see the I12 finding).

⑦⑧ OWED: a test that fails today, asserting that every hierarchy message whose rule accepts a Project parent names `contains` under the Project as the cure. Pin the class across all hierarchy messages, not this one string. Then the words.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: the residual need is real. Being under the Project still does not say "this part exists and is not ours". That is dec:idea-an-outside-part-is-marked-as-outside-and-an-outside-party-is-a-consumer, recorded as an idea.

CLOSED 2026-09-29: fixed by reflow2 PR #625 (squash 42259ba). hierarchy.rs now carries one PROJECT_PARENT_CURE sentence, which every hierarchy message a Project parent cures must name, pinned across all hierarchy issue kinds. Its change record, chg:a-finding-or-refusal-names-the-route-that-works, is in the committed design, not this live store. The residual "outside part" need in ⑨ stays with the idea it names.
